AI IN KHETI (5 minutes)
This slide is especially powerful for students in Fatehpur and UP because agriculture is part of their daily reality.
OPENING LINE — speak with genuine surprise: SAY: "You know what keeps me up at night? India is the second largest food producer in the world. And we lose 15-20% of our crops every year to diseases we didn't catch in time. What if AI could change that?"
WALK THROUGH THE STATS: - "10 days early" → "That's 10 extra days for the farmer to act. To spray. To save the harvest. That's the difference between eating and not eating." - "22 languages" → "The IFFCO Kisan app works in Hindi, Bhojpuri, and 20 other languages. The AI doesn't just see the farm — it talks to the farmer." - "₹0" → "Free. Because access to technology should not depend on how much money you have."
PERSONAL CONNECTION: ASK: "How many of you have family members who do farming?" (Hands go up) SAY: "This technology is being built specifically for families like yours."
CHECK FOR UNDERSTANDING (Icebreaker #2): SAY: "Name one thing in your life — at home, in school, or in your town — that might already have AI in it. 10 seconds to think." Take 5 answers. Build a spontaneous list. Show them how long it gets.
